load_bleu_metric: load the BLEU metric module from the Hugging Face Evaluate library using evaluate.load
launch_gradio_widget: launch an interactive Gradio widget for the BLEU metric evaluation interface
run_bleu_evaluation: run the BLEU metric evaluation on predictions and references using the loaded module
compute_bleu_score: compute BLEU scores for machine translation quality assessment with evaluate.load
test_bleu_metric: test the BLEU metric module loaded via evaluate.load for translation quality evaluation
